reason: I'd probably use the free visit, but $15 a visit plus gas adds up fast on our budget, and I can take the kids to the library or a park for nothing. I can't see paying $45 a month when money is this tight.
objection: It's a drive for us and gas adds up, on top of $15 each time. I'd be paying real money for something I can get free elsewhere.
would_change_my_mind: A $39 founding rate or a drop-in closer to $8-10, and it being close enough that the drive isn't a big gas cost.
